verdict.rationale: The axis applies: an IP-operations service with filing portals and data APIs could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring workflows such as watch alerts, renewal scheduling, or periodic data pulls. However, the evidence covers only one-off filing procedures (trademarks, patents, designs, e-Soleau), databases, and advisory services, with nothing about scheduling, recurring jobs, or automation triggers. The data-portal probe shows only token-gated access, not any scheduling capability.
